papers.title: LESSER: Post-Training Data Selection with Output-Layer Gradients
papers.abstract: The choice of post-training data for large language models substantially affects downstream performance. Gradient-based data selection is a popular approach that ranks training data by how well their gradients align with those of a small validation set. However, ranking with full-parameter gradients requires an expensive backward pass on every sample, making computation intractable for large candidate pools. This raises a natural question: can we approximate full-gradient features at a fraction
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.03702）：LESSER（Post-Training Data Selection with Output-Layer Gradients）解决 LLM post-training data selection 的算力瓶颈——现有 gradient-based selection 要对每个 candidate sample 跑 full-parameter backward pass，候选池大时算力不可承受。LESSER 用 output-layer gradients 做 ranking，在保留近似 full-gradient 信号的同时把算力降到常数倍。是 inference-serving × llm-evaluation × memory 的'output-layer gradient ranking'即时资产——'output-layer as governance surface for data selection'是 LLM training data curation 的工程化入口，与昨日 / 上周 TACO（optimizer state memory）在'把训练时 memory/compute 维度变成可量化工程对象'层面同源，与 aiutil 长期关注的 inference-serving × memory × llm-evaluation 主线在'低成本 ranking signal for data curation'层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 output-layer gradient 形式化（per-sample cost vs full）、跨 AdamW / LoRA / full-finetune baseline、跨 LLM 规模验证、与 influence-function / TracIn 等近似 ranking baseline 对照。今日动作：即时试点方向，写'lesser output-layer data-selection' checklist 草稿。

papers.title: 4DCodeBench: Benchmarking Agents on Inverse Graphics of Dynamic Scenes
papers.abstract: We introduce 4DCodeBench, a benchmark for 4D inverse graphics through code generation, in which agents reconstruct dynamic scenes from video as executable graphics programs. To accomplish this, agents must translate visual observations into compact representations of scene structure and dynamics, by implementing abstractions such as physical simulations to reproduce complex behavior. To evaluate this capability, we curate a set of real-world videos and construct synthetic scenes spanning diverse
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.03715）：4DCodeBench 把 4D inverse graphics 评测拉到 'video → executable graphics program' 的 code-generation agent 范式——agent 必须从 visual observation 翻译成 compact scene structure + dynamics 表示（含 physical simulation 抽象）作为 executable code 重现 dynamic scene。bench 包含 real-world videos 与 synthetic scenes。是 ai-agent × multimodal-agent × llm-evaluation 的'physics-grounded 4D code agent'即时资产——'reconstruct dynamic scene as executable code'范式可迁移到 embodied agent / world model / robotics sim2real 等子方向（agent 写出能跑出物理一致的 scene code），与 aiutil 长期关注的 ai-agent × multimodal-agent × coding-agent 主线高度对齐。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 code execution runtime、physical simulation abstraction 集合、跨 LLM baseline（GPT / Claude / Qwen）、'compact representation' 度量（symbolic vs learned）。今日动作：即时路线资产，写'4d-code-agent bench' checklist 草稿。

papers.title: EyeRobot 2.0: Active Gaze for Precise Manipulation without Wrist Cameras
papers.abstract: Inspired by human vision, we introduce a framework using active gaze to enable fine-grained bimanual manipulation with only a single stereo camera. EyeRobot 2.0 physically attends to a 3D fixation point in the scene by swiveling two eye viewpoints to center their gaze on it. The resulting images are processed foveally by allocating more visual tokens to the image centers, focusing computation on task-relevant features. Such Active Visual Fixation (AVF) requires carefully coordinated gaze during
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.03710）：EyeRobot 2.0 把 bimanual manipulation 的视觉感知从'fixed camera + uniform dense tokens'推到'active gaze + foveal token allocation'——single stereo camera 通过 swivel 注视 3D fixation point，foveally allocate 更多 visual tokens 给 image centers，focus computation on task-relevant features。是 multimodal-agent × ai-agent × inference-serving 的'active foveal sensing'趋势资产——'active gaze + foveal compute allocation'范式可迁移到任意 'perception-heavy agent' 子方向（VLM agent / embodied navigation / world model rollout），与昨日 / 上周 multimodal-agent 主线在'agent control over its own perception budget'层面同源。今日维持趋势卡片并设置 7 天观察周期。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 fixation point 选择策略、gaze-action 协调、跨 robot task 验证、token budget 与 uniform baseline 对照。

papers.title: What Should World Models Forget? Stratified Retention for Continual Adaptation
papers.abstract: Continual learning treats degradation on previously seen data as evidence of failure, a convention inherited from settings with a stationary prediction target, where a correct label remains correct indefinitely. World models do not satisfy this condition. Their prediction target is the environment, which changes, so knowledge that was accurate when acquired may later become false, and discarding it is required behavior rather than a defect. Non-stationary ground truth is well studied in the conc
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.03713）：What Should World Models Forget? 把 continual learning 的'retention convention'推到'world models have non-stationary ground truth, so forgetting is required behavior'——挑战 'degradation on previously seen data = failure' 的常规，是 ai-agent × multimodal-agent × inference-serving 的'stratified retention for non-stationary world models'趋势资产。'world-model forgetting as feature'范式可迁移到任意 'continual-learning non-stationary environment' 子方向（drift detection / adaptive memory / 在线学习），与 aiutil 长期关注的 ai-agent × multimodal-agent × inference-serving 主线在'world-model memory governance'层面同源。今日维持趋势卡片并设置 7 天观察周期。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 stratified retention 形式化、forget/schedule 协议、跨 world-model 验证、与 stationary continual learning baseline 对照。

papers.title: Language Models that Play Chess and Explain Their Moves
papers.abstract: Modern chess engines are silent experts: they play at a superhuman level, but do not offer explanations for their play. On the other hand, language models (LMs) can generate plausible-sounding explanations, but their weak playing strength limits the utility of their explanations. We introduce Queen, a 4B-parameter chess-language model that can explain its moves and plans while playing at the level of a typical Grandmaster. Our novel framework enables domain-specific reasoning through complementa
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.03695）：Queen（4B-parameter chess-language model）把 chess engine 从'silent expert'拉到'GM-strength explainable chess-LM'——LMs 能解释 moves/plans 但 playing strength 弱，引擎强但不解释。Queen 走 'domain-specific reasoning through complementation' 框架到 GM-level。是 llm-evaluation × ai-agent × rag-knowledge 的'explainable domain-LM'趋势资产——'complementary domain reasoning'范式可迁移到 code-LM、math-LM、tool-LM（强解 + 自解释），与 aiutil 长期关注的 llm-evaluation × ai-agent × rag-knowledge 主线在'domain-LM as explanation surface'层面同源。今日维持趋势卡片并设置 7 天观察周期。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 complementation 框架、跨 chess engine baseline（Stockfish / Leela）、explanation 评测协议、与现有 chess-LM 对照。

papers.title: Less Decoder is More Encoder: Geometric Representation Learning from Novel View Synthesis
papers.abstract: This paper examines the role of Novel View Synthesis (NVS) in geometric representation learning. In principle, NVS should reason about 3D scene structure, thereby enabling transferable multi-view geometric representations. Yet, existing encoder-based NVS methods yield poor representations. This is not because of a lack of supervisory signal, but rather due to inconspicuous architectural choices: \textit{spatially expressive decoders} that dilute representational capabilities of the scene encoder
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.03717）：Less Decoder is More Encoder 把 Novel View Synthesis 拉到 'encoder-based geometric representation learning'——point out 'spatially expressive decoders dilute representational capabilities of the scene encoder'，NVS 失败不在 supervisory signal 而在 architectural choice。是 multimodal-agent × inference-serving 的'encoder/decoder decoupling for geometric repr'长尾架构资产——'architectural choice as bottleneck' 论断可迁移到 3D foundation model / world model / generative 3D（哪个组件在 dilute repr），与昨日 / 上周 multimodal-agent × 3D 主线在'geometric representation learning architecture'层面同源。今日维持长尾卡片。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 encoder/decoder architecture、跨 NVS baseline 对照、transferability to downstream 3D task。

papers.title: RNADyn: A Benchmark for Generating and Understanding RNA Dynamics
papers.abstract: Ribonucleic acid (RNA) functions through conformational changes that are not fully captured by static structures. However, large-scale standardized RNA dynamics data remain limited, and existing approaches typically treat trajectory generation and dynamics understanding as separate objectives. Here, we introduce RNADynBench, a standardized RNA molecular dynamics (MD) benchmark with 2585 quality-controlled 100-ns all-atom trajectories and leakage-controlled splits. Building on RNADynBench, we dev
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.03712）：RNADynBench 是 RNA 分子动力学标准化 benchmark——2585 quality-controlled 100-ns all-atom trajectories，leakage-controlled splits，明确把 trajectory generation 与 dynamics understanding 联立而非分离。是 llm-evaluation × multimodal-agent 的'RNA MD benchmark with leakage control'长尾评测资产——'joint generation + understanding benchmark + leakage control'范式可迁移到任何 molecular dynamics / protein / material 子方向，与 aiutil 长期关注的 llm-evaluation × multimodal-agent 主线在'cross-domain benchmark methodology'层面同源。今日维持长尾卡片。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 leakage 控制协议、轨迹质量度量、generation model baseline、跨 trajectory length 验证。

papers.title: From Mixing to Tearing: Graph Decomposition in Decentralized Optimization via Message Passing
papers.abstract: We study the minimization of sums of smooth strongly convex functions over undirected graphs, with each function held by one agent and communication restricted to neighbors in the graph. Existing decentralized methods, whether based on gossip or on routing over spanning trees, typically use the network to mix or aggregate information to enable {\it prescribed} local optimization updates. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.03709）：From Mixing to Tearing 把 decentralized optimization 从 'gossip/routing mixing for prescribed local updates' 推到 'graph decomposition via message passing, jointly reason structure + updates'——network 不再只是 mix 工具，而是 decomposition 工具。是 inference-serving × ai-k8s-platform 的'graph-decomposition decentralized optimization'长尾理论资产——'graph as decomposition tool, not mixing tool' 范式可迁移到 federated learning / distributed inference / multi-agent consensus 等子方向，与 aiutil 长期关注的 inference-serving × ai-k8s-platform 主线在'distributed optimization theory'层面同源。今日维持长尾卡片。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 message passing 算法、graph decomposition 形式化、跨 graph topology 验证、与 gossip baseline 对照。

papers.title: Simulation-Free Learning of Population Dynamics with Wasserstein Lagrangian Residuals
papers.abstract: The dynamics of cells, organisms, and fluids are often modeled as probability distributions evolving over time. Reconstructing and extrapolating this evolution from unpaired snapshots requires assumptions about the underlying process. Wasserstein gradient flows are a common choice, but they cannot describe conservative or periodic dynamics. Lagrangian mechanics in Wasserstein space covers both, but existing methods for learning it are simulation-based: they run a numerical solver at every traini
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.03679）：Simulation-Free Wasserstein Lagrangian Residuals 把 population dynamics learning 从 'simulation-based Lagrangian mechanics learning' 推到 'residual-based / simulation-free'——Lagrangian mechanics in Wasserstein space 涵盖 conservative / periodic dynamics（plain Wasserstein gradient flow 不能），但之前要 numerical solver 每 training step 跑；本文走 simulation-free 路径。是 inference-serving × llm-evaluation 的'simulation-free Lagrangian residual'长尾理论资产——'simulation-free learning of continuous-time generative process' 范式可迁移到 diffusion model 训练 / score-based learning / 时间序列生成，与 aiutil 长期关注的 inference-serving × llm-evaluation 主线在'generative process learning theory'层面同源。今日维持长尾卡片。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 residual 形式化、simulation-free 收敛保证、跨 dynamics benchmark、与 simulation-based baseline 对照。

papers.title: Transcriptome-informed multi-modal AI for predicting neoadjuvant therapy response from breast cancer biopsies
papers.abstract: Scarcity of labeled data limits development of deep learning biomarkers in oncology. We develop a two-stage AI model predicting pathological complete response (pCR) to neoadjuvant therapy in breast cancer. The first stage learns the transcriptome from histopathology using 8,742 patients across 32 cancer types, corroborated by pathologist review and spatial agreement with measured expression. This simplifies the second stage to predicting pCR from inferred expression and clinical variables. Devel
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.03693）：Transcriptome-informed multi-modal AI 用 8,742 patients across 32 cancer types 学 'histopathology → transcriptome' 第一阶段，corroborated by pathologist review + spatial agreement；第二阶段用 inferred expression + clinical 预测 pCR（neoadjuvant therapy response）。是 llm-evaluation × multimodal-agent 的'two-stage multi-modal AI with cross-modal supervision'长尾跨域应用资产——'learn modality A from modality B to predict modality C target'范式可迁移到其他 scarce-labeled medical AI（pathology + omics）、遥感（光学 + SAR）等领域。今日维持长尾卡片并设置 21 天复盘周期。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 cross-modal 监督协议、pCR 评测指标、跨 cancer type 验证、与现有 pCR baseline 对照。
